caseContext.meaning: Capture availability versus this case cutoff only. Financial period, event date and hypothetical decision cutoff inside the task remain distinct.

payload.latencyBasis: Shared analyst batch: timestamp sampled during initial permitted packet/source setup after READY; all 26 cases were inspected and authored in one session. The elapsed interval is not isolated per-case latency, provider inference time, or per-case cost. finishedAt is actual exclusive-write time.

extractedNumbers.period: hypothetical original decision to incoming capture

payload.toolCallsBasis: Shared source-inspection and batch-authoring tool calls are counted once in telemetry.json, not allocated to individual cases.
payload.telemetryNormalization: Empty dedicated-call array means zero dedicated calls; shared calls remain in original telemetry. No output or numerical answer changed.
payload.modelIdentityBasis: Local configured model inheritance; not independent provider attestation
